title: Eso attā
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || 4 Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || pe || || 5 Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ ditthi uppajjati || So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || 6-9 Vedanāya || Saññāya || Saṅkhāresu || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati [page 183] XXII. 152. 5-7] DIṬṬHIVAGGO PAÑCAMO 183 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || 10 Tam kim maññatha bhikkhave rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yampanāniccam dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || || Dukkham bhante || || Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya || So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || No hetam bhante || || 11-14 Vedanā || Saññā || {Saṅkhārā} || Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || || Dukkham bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya || So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || No hetam bhante || || 15 Evam passaṃ || || pe || || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
